::: {.remark .notes}

@thm-mixture-two-stage describes how to generate a draw from a mixture:
first draw a component label $C$ with $\P(C = c) = w_c$,
then draw $X$ from the component density ${\p_C}$.
In applications, $C$ is often an unobserved subpopulation,
such as a disease subtype.
Mixtures of multivariate densities,
such as mixtures of [multivariate normal densities](#def-mvn)
(Gaussian mixture models),
work the same way, with $p$-variable densities in place of densities on $\reals$.

:::
